main_text.l: nequit quod poteft non effe; ita Deum non
concipit aut Dei effentiam, qui tale quip-
piam concipit quod poteft non effe. Sunt
tamen etiam in Deo diffimiles effentiæ &
exiftentiæ conceptus, fed ob id folum
quod effentia pertineat ad quæstionem
quid fit, exiftentia ad quæstionem, an fit;
quæ ratio, ut est generalis, ita sufficit ad di-
stinctionem rationis ratiocinatæ.
CAP. IX.
De principiis Metaphysicæ complexis.
THESIS I.
PRincipia Complexa, vel sunt Hypo-
theses, vel Definitiones, vel Axioma-
ta. Hypothesis Metaphysica est, quà
præsupponit dari Ens quodpiam. Ut cæte-
ræ scientiæ, ita quoque Metaphysica præ-
supponit suum subjectum esse: atque ita
quidem, ut id nulli scientiæ debeat acce-
ptum; nam præterquam, quod ipsa sit pri-
ma omnium scientiarum, ita notum est, da-
ri Entia, ut id probari neque debeat neque
possit.
II. Secundo loco sumit Metaphysi-
ca nominalem definitionem Entis; atque
omnium adeo terminorum, quibus utitur:

page.notes: The first letter of the thesis is a large initial "P" joined to "Rincipia"; it is written as printed. "rationis" in the top paragraph shows a smudge between the words, and the word may be partly obscured. The first word of the top paragraph is a fragment, so it stays a fragment. The "Atque" at lower right is a catchword and is therefore not repeated in the text. The "Digitized by Google" watermark at lower right is not transcribed.
